init.title: Start method and timing
init.description: Native sends the start through VeSync. SwitchBot loads the program, waits until the fryer reports it is ready and then lets the Bot press the physical start button. Automatic tries native first and uses the SwitchBot only when the fryer waits for its button. A start only counts once VeSync reports the zone cooking. The Bot's press duration is set in the SwitchBot app; Home Assistant cannot change it.
